## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite validator should enforce the twelve-character minimum so the new password policy applies to invited users.

## Changes
The pull request raises the password minimum for signup and reset from eight to twelve characters and updates both validators’ boundary tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Enforce the twelve-character minimum for invites — The invite validator accepts `xxxxxxxx` under the twelve-character policy introduced by the signup change because `app/invite.py:1` still sets its minimum to eight. — Invited users can choose passwords of eight to eleven characters, below the new security requirement. — Fix: Set the minimum in `app/invite.py:1` to twelve and update `tests/test_invite.py::test_password_boundaries`.

## Suggestions
(none)
